title: Introduce temporal-consistency evaluator and cohort replay CI hook
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Add temporal-consistency metric and a cohort replay CI hook. Enables time-aware regression detection and automated replay/backfill for flagged prompt cohorts.
description:
Motivation: Some regressions in prompt sets are temporal — model responses shift gradually as model updates or prompt traffic patterns change. Existing cohort gates surface aggregate drops but lack a focused, time-aware signal and an automated way to reproduce and replay affected request windows for root-cause analysis. This PR adds a temporal-consistency evaluator plus a CI hook that can schedule targeted cohort replays and request replays against pinned model snapshots.

What this does: - Implements a temporal-consistency metric that computes inter-window agreement and detects degradations when contiguous time windows diverge beyond a tunable threshold. - Adds a cohort_replay_hook that, when a cohort fails the temporal gate in CI, schedules a replay job that pulls sample inputs from the failing window and executes them against the baseline and candidate model versions for deterministic diffs. - Provides a lightweight replay runner CLI and a containerized script (scripts/replay_runner.sh) to run replays in isolated CI runners. - Includes unit/integration tests and docs for operators to tune thresholds and interpret output.

Checklist: - [x] Metric implementation and unit tests - [x] CI hook wiring and smoke pipeline - [x] Replay runner and replay artifacts schema - [x] Docs and runbook for oncall - [x] Metric telemetry and basic dashboards (follow-up detailed dashboard PR)

References: Linear ENG-4127 (temporal metric design), ENG-4198 (cohort replay orchestration). See docs/eval/temporal_consistency.md for algorithm details and examples.

Notes on behavior: The temporal metric works on sliding windows (configurable size) and reports both absolute divergence and a normalized stability score. The CI hook is gated behind a feature flag (EVAL_TEMPORAL_HOOK) and will not run replays by default; config for auto-replay can be enabled per-team. Replay artifacts are stored to the eval-artifacts bucket under a folder named by PR/CI run id for easy triage.

feat(hooks): add cohort_replay_hook + orchestration + feature flag
feat(replay): replay runner CLI and scripts/replay_runner.sh
test: add unit tests and integration smoke case for temporal metric
ci: wire hook into ci/pipelines/eval_smoke.yml and add replay artifact upload
docs: add temporal_consistency.md and runbook snippets
review_comments: Jordan Kim: Nice approach — can you clarify the normalization used when window sizes differ? (see inline in temporal_consistency.py)
Author (Aisha): Answered — we normalize by harmonic mean of window counts and include a fallback to per-example rate when window counts < 30.
Luca Moretti: CI replay runner should limit parallelism to avoid noisy quota spikes; please add a concurrency cap (suggested default 8).
Author (Aisha): Added --concurrency flag and default to 4 in scripts/replay_runner.sh; updated docs.
Priya Desai: Would like explicit metrics for replays (duration, errors, baseline-vs-candidate delta); add to telemetry.md?
Author (Aisha): Added initial telemetry emitters and stubbed dashboards; follow-up ticket ENG-4239 to expand dashboards.
summary: Adds temporal-consistency metric and a gated replay CI hook to improve time-aware regression detection and enable deterministic repros for failing cohorts.
